facts.business: Websol Energy System Limited is one of India's longest-established manufacturers of solar photovoltaic cells and modules at a single, fully integrated site.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: As on 31 March 2026: 1,200 MW; doubled during the year under review; prepared to grow beyond 3 GW in 2027

guidance_or_targets.statement: Websol announced its intent to move upstream into raw material manufacturing
Websol prepared to grow beyond 3 GW in 2027
Websol funded its growth largely from its earnings, becoming net debt negative in FY26

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Accuracy of recognition, measurement, presentation and disclosures of revenues and other related balances in accordance with Ind AS 115 'Revenue from Contracts with Customers'
